channel.title: AIArchive — model preservation news
channel.description: Captures, mirrors, takedown alerts and trending models, generated by the archive's automation

item.title: This week's captures center on two labs: inclusionAI added ZwZ2 models at 4B, 9B, and 27B (with GGUF builds for all three) plus several Ling-3.0 and Ling-3.1 flash variants, while openbmb posted a wide MiniCPM-OCR-1.0 and OCR-Jev lineup in AWQ, GPTQ, gguf, int4, and DSpark formats. Tencent's WeVisCut was also captured. No models were mirrored and no alerts were raised; radar signals were mostly new papers referencing DeepSeek and Qwen, plus an HN front-page post (97 points) noting five inference providers for abliterated DeepSeek.
